title: It sounds big and flashy, but $1M a year isn't as much as you'd think...
description: It sounds big and flashy, but $1M a year isn't as much as you'd think...🤔
transcript: Getting to a million a year in revenue was nowhere near as exciting as I thought it would be. I think when you think of like, oh, I'm generating $1 million a year in my business, you think that would be a lot. But then you start going through it, you think, okay, well that's revenue, not profit, so you gotta deduct your costs. Even if your business is brilliantly run with high margins, you're probably looking at 30, 40% of that. So it's 3 400 K. Half it's gonna go to the tax man. If you choose to take that out and it's like, you might have a million dollar a year business and you're making 100 k, it's like, okay. You start realising, right, for this to be anything exciting, it needs to be 10 x. And if I really want to achieve my objectives, we need to be doing something like 100 million a year. And you just sort of move that target way higher than you initially thought it needed to be.
